annotations.title: Is this employer hiring right now

description: How many roles an employer opened in the last 14 days, from the ads JobCrawls sees open: a hiring-activity signal, not a promise to hire. Takes a companyId from a search result. Returns nothing when no role opened, when first-seen dates are unreliable, or for staffing agencies. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

companyId.description: The companyId from a search result or a company card. Not a display name.

name: get_company_hiring_now

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.
